# Tier `maxwell-3`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cuda` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 32768 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `f16` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `gemma4-e2b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 32768 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | dropped | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares no persistent vLLM agent seat: the agent lane runs on the
llama.cpp seat named by `agent_model` above, in the tier's own llama-swap config.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gemma4-e2b-vision` | vision | `vision_model` | `gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo-q8_0.bin` | swappable |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

The installer seeds this tier's media bindings (`config_seed`):

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `animategen_script` | `` |
| `compose_script` | `render/compose-hyperframes.mjs` |
| `imagegen_cfg` | `1` |
| `imagegen_engine` | `sdcpp` |
| `imagegen_family` | `sdxl-turbo` |
| `imagegen_steps` | `4` |
| `imagegen_timeout_sec` | `900` |
| `musicgen_script` | `` |
| `run_graph_script` | `` |
| `sdcpp_bin` | `__OFFLOAD_HOME__/sdcpp/sd-cli__EXE__` |
| `sdcpp_model` | `__OFFLOAD_HOME__/models/sdxl-turbo/stable-diffusion-xl-1.0-turbo-Q4_0.gguf` |
| `sdcpp_model_kind` | `checkpoint` |
| `vae_mode` | `tiling` |
| `videogen_script` | `` |
| `voicegen_script` | `` |

`__OFFLOAD_HOME__` is replaced with the install root at render time.

## Installer-seeded config (non-media)

These `config_seed` keys are applied to a FRESH harness config exactly like the media
seed, but they bind no media route — the agent/cascade seats and per-node knobs live
here so they are never mistaken for a media capability:

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `agent_profile` | `research` |
| `escalation_model` | `` |
| `fleet_max_concurrent_jobs` | `1` |
| `model` | `gemma4-e2b` |
| `reasoning_model` | `` |

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Config #18: the 3 GB band (sm_52 Maxwell, GTX 970M-class). Reference box <node-g>, the 2015 gaming laptop: GTX 970M 3 GB GDDR5, a 4-core/8-thread Skylake mobile CPU, 32 GB DDR4. Spec: docs/specs/2026-10-28-maxwell-3-tier-design.md. Every value below marked PROJECTED is replaced by its measurement on that box before this tier is called measured; the MEASURED figures are from the 2026-10-28 smoke. ENGINE (MEASURED 2026-10-28): the pinned llama.cpp b11490 win-cuda-12.4 prebuilt runs on sm_52 through its embedded sm_50 PTX - a one-time JIT of ~36 s cached under CUDA_CACHE_PATH (the install sets CUDA_CACHE_MAXSIZE so the cache is never evicted); CUDA graphs are disabled below Volta by the backend itself (disable_cuda_graphs true is documentary), there is no fp16 math and no MMQ, so prefill is dequant-to-F32 + cuBLAS, and flash-attn runs through the f32 vec/tile kernels - MEASURED FASTER on this card, so it stays on. E2B UD-Q4_K_XL llama-bench: pp512 374 t/s, tg128 39.2 t/s (43.1 t/s with flash-attn on); llama-server fits 8K/16K/32K with q8_0 KV at 1434/1468/1535 MiB and 16K f16 flash-attn-on at 1517 MiB (40.7 t/s); 1037 MHz, 56-60 C, 22-28 W. RESIDENT TIER E2B, E4B OMITTED (omit_e4b): the E4B needs 3,100 MiB at 16K (measured on <node-c>), more than the 3,072 MiB card holds beside the resident embedder and the WDDM reserve, so the workhorse here is the E2B, config_seed.model names it, and the 6 GB band's E4B entry and download are dropped rather than rendered into an OOM. CTX 32K, f16 KV: the Gemma-4 E-series KV barely grows (512-token sliding window), f16 costs tens of MiB over q8_0 at 32K, and q8_0's dequant has no fp16 path on this card. 26B DROPPED: no placement fits a 3 GB card. AGENT SEAT: none bound yet (PROJECTED): the agent lane falls back to the workhorse E2B (config_seed.model) until the bake on <node-g> (the 2026-08-17 ampere-6 instrument, shapes B and C, fabrication disqualifies, bar 0.5) picks the best candidate that fits beside the resident embedder in the ~2.4 GiB swappable budget: Qwen3.5-4B UD-IQ3_XXS, Qwen3.5-2B UD-Q4_K_XL, MiniCPM5-2B Q4_K_M, LFM3-1.7B (needs llama.cpp b11938 or later; a win there bumps the global pin to b11946, which keeps the sm_50 PTX). The winner gets its own single-slot entry (explicit --parallel 1) and agent_model binds to it. MEDIA SEATS (MEASURED 2026-10-28, one real call each on the card, details in each seat's `measured`): vision gemma4-e2b-vision = the resident E2B weights + the ggml-org Q8_0 projector at ctx 8192 with reasoning off, 2,197 MiB loaded / 2,438 MiB peak as a seat (2,578 / 2,819 on the card with the 381 MiB embedder), a website screenshot described and a receipt extracted correctly in Spanish; stt whisper-stt = large-v3-turbo q8_0 + silero v5.1.2 with flash attention OFF (-nfa, the house Spanish-audio rule), 1,263 / 1,323 MiB measured alone, a 759 KB Spanish clip in 3.2 s warmed; q5_0 and flash attention on give the same transcript 0.3-0.4 s faster and 150-440 MiB lighter, so q8_0 is the quality pick, not the fast one. Both are SWAPPABLE: the embedder, the 2,009 MiB chat seat and either media seat together overflow the card, so a media call evicts the chat seat and the next chat call reloads it in ~3 s. Their weights are pin-only in install.ps1 (model-e2b-mmproj, model-whisper-turbo-q8, model-silero-v5): placed by the operator, warned about by `install render` when absent. IMAGE (MEASURED 2026-10-28): the house sd.cpp Vulkan pin (master-95ff762) with sdxl-turbo Q4_0 renders a correct 512x512 in 45 s on this card (4 steps, cfg 1, euler, vae tiling): sd.cpp keeps the 3.6 GB of weights in host RAM and stages them to the card per step (its auto budget on a 3 GB card; 1,964 MiB peak on the card, the RAM released when the job exits), which is the spill shape the house allows for sd.cpp. The lane picks the discrete adapter itself (the Intel iGPU on this laptop renders the same image 3.5x slower). config_seed binds it exactly as ampere-6 does; the binary and the weights are placed by the operator, since the installer media leg is the amd-rdna3 set. RAM SPILL (ADR 0080): the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B spill seat is not carried on this band until its three gates (adds capability, no RAM hog, stable) are measured here; fleet_max_concurrent_jobs stays 1 (one slot). NOT a Blackwell-style CUDA-13 box: the cuda-13 prebuilts carry no Maxwell code, so Select-CudaBuild keeps the 12.4 prebuilt for this profile.
